title.zh: 巴士服务行业（行为与活动管制——巴士转换站）条例 2026
title.en: Bus Services Industry (Control of Conduct and Activities — Bus Interchange) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 21 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

chapter.en: PART 1 PRELIMINARY

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Bus Services Industry (Control of Conduct and Activities — Bus Interchange) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 23 September 2026.

chapter.en: PART 1 PRELIMINARY
PART 2 CONDITIONS OF USE OF BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Conditions of use of bus interchange

text.en: 3. A person using the bus interchange must comply with the conditions in regulations 5 to 21 (called in these Regulations conditions of use).

chapter.en: PART 2 CONDITIONS OF USE OF BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Directions for breach of conditions of use

text.en:
4.—(1) This regulation applies if —
(a)a person (X) using a bus interchange fails to comply with any condition of use; or
(b)where X is entering, or about to enter, a bus interchange — X is likely to fail to comply with any condition of use if allowed to enter the bus interchange.
(2) An authorised person may —
(a)refuse X entry to the bus interchange; or
(b)direct X to leave the bus interchange.
(3) A person who fails to comply with any direction of an authorised person given under paragraph (2) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
5.—(1) A person must not enter any restricted area within a bus interchange.
(2) In this regulation, “restricted area” means any part of a bus interchange that is demarcated by the LTA or the licensee to be inaccessible to any person other than persons authorised by the LTA or the licensee.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Bringing prohibited articles or things into bus interchange

text.en:
6.—(1) A person must not bring into a bus interchange any luggage, article or thing that causes, or is likely to cause, any inconvenience, nuisance, obstruction, discomfort or injury to other persons within the bus interchange.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Riding bicycle or personal mobility device

text.en:
7.—(1) A person must not ride a bicycle or personal mobility device within a bus interchange.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Sewage, drainage waste and offensive matter

text.en:
8.—(1) A person must not cause any sewage, drainage waste or other offensive matter to —
(a)flow into or enter a bus interchange; or
(b)be placed in any part of a bus interchange.
(2) However, paragraph (1) does not apply to a person if the person has the written permission of the licensee to carry out the activity mentioned in that paragraph.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $1,000.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
9.—(1) A person must not consume, or attempt to consume, any chewing gum or bubble gum within a bus interchange.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
10.—(1) A person must not —
(a)place or throw any litter within a bus interchange except into receptacles provided for that purpose; or
(b)soil any part of a bus interchange, or any fittings, equipment or property within a bus interchange.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
11.—(1) A person must not conduct himself or herself within a bus interchange in a manner that causes, or is likely to cause, nuisance or annoyance to other users of the bus interchange.
Examples
1.A person who places his or her feet, or footwear, on any seat within the bus interchange, is causing annoyance to other users of the bus interchange.
2.A person who uses within a bus interchange any mobile phone, wireless handheld device (such as a tablet computer) or wearable device (such as a smart watch) which produces a loud sound that may be heard by other persons in the bus interchange is causing annoyance to other users of the bus interchange.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
12.—(1) A person must not —
(a)intentionally cause any bodily pain or infirmity, or intentionally spread any disease, to any other person within a bus interchange; or
(b)cause any bodily pain or infirmity, or spread any disease, to any other person within a bus interchange if the person knows, or ought reasonably to know, that he or she is likely to cause bodily pain or infirmity, or spread that disease, to that other person.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
13.—(1) A person, while within a bus interchange, must not —
(a)tout or solicit alms, rewards or employment of any description;
(b)sell or offer for sale any article or goods, or carry on any business; or
(c)display, exhibit or distribute any book or printed, written or pictorial matter or any such samples for the purpose of advertising or publicity.
(2) However, paragraph (1) does not apply to a person if the person has the written permission of the LTA or the licensee to carry out the activity mentioned in that paragraph.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $1,000.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
14.—(1) A person must not place himself or herself, or place or leave any animal or any object under the person’s possession or charge, within a bus interchange such that it causes obstruction, hindrance or danger to any other person within that bus interchange.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 3 CONDUCT AND ACTIVITIES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Compliance with directions, etc., of authorised person

text.en:
15.—(1) A person, while within a bus interchange, must comply with all reasonable directions and instructions of any authorised person given to —
(a)ensure the safety of that person or any other person within the bus interchange; or
(b)deal with any emergency or unforeseen circumstances.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 4 USE OF EQUIPMENT IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
16.—(1) A person must not —
(a)touch, use, meddle or otherwise interfere with any door or any other mechanical or electrical equipment or installation in a bus interchange;
(b)touch, use, meddle or otherwise interfere with any switch, lever or other device operating or controlling any equipment or installation mentioned in sub‑paragraph (a); or
(c)activate or use any emergency or safety device installed within a bus interchange.
(2) However, paragraph (1) does not apply to a person if —
(a)the person is responding to an emergency and is acting according to instructions mentioned in any notice displayed by the LTA or the licensee within the bus interchange;
(b)the person is an officer or employee of the LTA, or an employee of the licensee, and is acting in the discharge of his or her duties; or
(c)the person activates or uses the emergency or safety device mentioned in paragraph (1)(c) for the purpose for which the device is provided and in accordance with the instructions printed on that device.
(3) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 4 USE OF EQUIPMENT IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
17.—(1) A person must not —
(a)without reasonable excuse, sit on any step or pallet of any escalator or travelator in a bus interchange; or
(b)sit or ride on any handrail of any escalator or travelator in a bus interchange.
(2) A person must not use, or attempt to use, any escalator or travelator in a bus interchange except to travel from one end of the escalator or travelator to the other by means of the escalator stairway or travelator pallet.
(3) A person must not travel, or attempt to travel, on any moving escalator or travelator in a bus interchange in a direction other than the direction in which the escalator or travelator is moving.
(4) A person who contravenes paragraph (1), (2) or (3) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $500.

chapter.en: PART 5 VEHICLES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Vehicles not to be left within bus interchange

text.en:
18.—(1) A person must not leave, or cause to be left, any vehicle on any part of a bus interchange unless the person has the written permission of the LTA or the licensee.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 5 VEHICLES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Vehicle drivers to comply with signs, etc.

text.en:
19.—(1) A driver of a vehicle, while within a bus interchange, must comply with —
(a)all traffic signs and signals; and
(b)any reasonable directions and instructions of any authorised person given to regulate traffic within the bus interchange.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $1,000.

chapter.en: PART 5 VEHICLES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

text.en:
20.—(1) A person must not drive any vehicle into or within a bus interchange at a rate of speed or in a manner that is likely to cause danger to others.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $5,000.

chapter.en: PART 5 VEHICLES IN BUS INTERCHANGE

heading.en: Vehicles prohibited within certain areas of bus interchange

text.en:
21.—(1) A person must not drive any vehicle (other than a mobility vehicle) within any area of a bus interchange set apart for the exclusive use of pedestrians.
(2) A person who contravenes paragraph (1) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $2,000.
